description:
1997 American Platinum Eagle containing 1/4 troy ounce of .9995 fine platinum, from the inaugural year of the U.S. Mint’s Platinum Eagle program. The obverse features John Mercanti’s Statue of Liberty portrait; the reverse features Thomas D. Rogers’ eagle soaring above a rising sun, with the platinum purity, weight and $25 denomination. Bullion issue with no mint, housed in a clear protective flip with the dealer’s labels.
Offered from the inventory of a recently retired Wisconsin numismatic dealer whose esteemed career spanned nearly five decades. Widely known and respected by fellow dealers and collectors across the country, he was a familiar, trusted presence at coin and antique shows. He provided coin collection appraisals for banks, jewelry stores, insurance companies, and private clients. He also served as president of civic and professional numismatic organizations, and played an integral role in the early lobbying efforts toward Wisconsin’s eventual sales tax exemption for precious metal bullion sales.
***This is a SHIPPING ONLY auction! All items will be fully insured. Items will be shipped on Monday October 26. By placing your bid, you agree to pay the shipping and handling fees. There is NO in person pickup option for this auction!

Description
: Bring a touch of industrial history to your space with this collection of 10 assorted color Hemingray glass insulators. Each piece offers its unique patina, displaying hues of clear, aqua, and light green glass with vintage charm and visible air bubbles, mold seams, and embossed markings. These insulators, once used on telegraph and telephone poles, now offer collectors and decorators a glimpse into classic American utility design. Whether grouped together or displayed individually, their rounded shapes and subtle imperfections enhance their visual appeal. The glass construction ensures long-lasting durability, while the recognizable Hemingray embossing adds legitimacy and collector value. Ideal for display in a curio cabinet, as paperweights, or for upcycling in home decor projects, this lot brings both style and history. All items are in used condition with some signs of age, minor dirt, and expected wear, but no obvious major cracks or chips. Perfect for collectors or those seeking distinctive vintage decor

title: Hemingray & Glass Insulators 3 Piece Lot Aqua Teal Clear Vintage
description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.
